description.html: Dubia roaches are the most popular feeder insect for lizards and the staple of most insect eaters' diets. They are high in protein, low in chitin and have a soft shell, so they are easy to digest and suitable for both babies and adults. Unlike crickets, dubia roaches do not chirp, jump or climb smooth surfaces, and they do not give off an unpleasant smell - they are practical to keep and survive longer in the terrarium if the animal does not eat them right away.

description.text: Sizes and which animals they suit

description.html: We offer three sizes. Small (nymphs) are ideal for baby bearded dragons, leopard geckos and other smaller lizards. Medium suit juvenile animals, while large (adults) are meant for bigger lizards and adult agamas. Size rule: the insect must not be wider than the space between the animal's eyes. Dust live food with calcium before feeding, and occasionally with a multivitamin.

Prices start at 600 din for 100 pieces, depending on size. Call us or message us on WhatsApp for the exact price and availability. Courier delivery across Serbia, free pickup in Novi Sad. We are happy to recommend the right type and size of food for your animal - free of charge.
